formulations.FRAME_2D: Euler-Bernoulli elastic beam-column, 3 DOF per node, small displacement, linear coordinate transformation
formulations.TRUSS_2D: Two-node axial elastic truss embedded in the same 3-DOF assembly; rz at a truss-only node is explicitly excluded as a non-formulation DOF, while every translational DOF remains in the rank check
formulations.load_application: Nodal forces and nodal moments only; no implicit code load combination or member-load conversion

official_method_sources.title: OpenSees Elastic Beam Column Element
official_method_sources.relevance: Official parameterization A, E, Iz and geometric transformation for a 2D elastic beam-column element

official_method_sources.title: OpenSees Linear Transformation
official_method_sources.relevance: Official definition of the linear local-to-global beam coordinate transformation

official_method_sources.title: OpenSees Truss Element
official_method_sources.relevance: Official axial truss element scope and explicit warning that geometric nonlinearities are not included

official_method_sources.title: OpenSees PDelta Transformation
official_method_sources.relevance: Documents P-Delta as a separate transformation, supporting the explicit exclusion from this linear kernel

analytical_benchmarks: Axial bar: u = P L / (E A)
Cantilever tip transverse load: v = P L^3 / (3 E I), rotation = P L^2 / (2 E I)
Simply supported beam with central point load: v_mid = P L^3 / (48 E I), R_A = R_B = P/2
explicit_limitations: No P-Delta or corotational geometric nonlinearity
No material nonlinearity, cracking, yielding or prestress
No eigenvalue buckling, dynamic, wind, seismic or fatigue analysis
No connection, bearing, foundation, soil-structure or construction-stage model
No standard load generation, load combination, resistance factor or capacity check
A source_ref and hash establish provenance only; they do not prove applicability
Rank and condition checks use every free translational DOF plus rotational DOFs attached to FRAME_2D; only rz at truss-only nodes is excluded and reported explicitly

Reported condition_number belongs to a reduced stiffness matrix nondimensionalized by scaling each rotational coordinate with the inverse characteristic model length; it is not the dimensioned raw-matrix condition number
max_translation_to_characteristic_length = 0.05 is a conservative research/software applicability guard for the small-displacement formulation, not a bridge-code serviceability limit
promotion_requirements: Cross-check against a separate trusted solver on representative arch/truss models
Project-specific load combinations and section resistance checks with cited standard clauses
P-Delta/eigen-buckling and staged-construction analysis before structural design use
